Qur'an-e-Hakim afaqi kitab-e-hidayat hai aur har jagah bhi farmaya hai ke koi cheez aisi nahi jo is ki tasbih is ki hamd ke sath na karti ho, tamam makhlooq khwah asman ki ho, khwah zameen ki, is ki tareefon aur pakeegiyon ke bayan mein masroof-o-mashghool hai, woh asman-o-zameen ka badshah aur un dono mein apna poora tasarruf aur atal hukum jari karne wala hai, woh tamam nuqsanat se pak aur be-aib hai, tamam sifaat-e-kamaliyah ke sath mawsoof hai, woh Aziz-o-Hakim hai. Is ki tafseer kayi baar guzar chuki hai. Ummiyyoon se murad Arab hain. Jaise aur jagah farman-e-bari hai: Al-ayah. Yaani tu Ahl-e-Kitab aur anparh logon se keh de ke kya tum ne Islam qubool kiya? aur woh musalman hojayen toh woh rah-e-rast par hain aur agar munh pher lein toh tujh par toh sirf pohncha dena hai aur bandon ki poori dekh bhal karne wala Allah Ta'ala hai. Yahan Arab ka zikr karna is liye nahi ke ghair Arab ki nafi ho balki sirf is liye ke un par ehsan-o-ikram ba-nisbat doosron ke bohat zyada hai. Jaise aur jagah hai: Wa innahu la-zikrun laka wa li-qawmika, yaani yeh tere liye bhi naseehat hai aur teri qoum ke liye bhi, yahan bhi qoum ki khusoosiyat nahi kyunke Qur'an-e-Kareem sab jahan walon ke liye naseehat hai, isi tarah aur jagah farman hai (tarjuma): Apne qarabat-dar aur kunba walon ko dara de, yahan bhi yeh matlab hargiz nahi ke aap ki tanbeeh sirf apne ghar walon ke sath hi مخصوص (makhsoos) hai balki aam hai, irshad-e-bari hai (tarjuma): Logo! Main tum sab ki taraf Allah ka rasool hoon, aur jagah farman hai (tarjuma): Yaani is ke sath main tumhein khabardar kar doon aur har us shakhs ko jise yeh pohnche. Isi tarah Qur'an ke baare mein farmaya (tarjuma): Tamam giroh mein se jo bhi is ka inkar kare woh jahannami hai. Isi tarah ki aur bhi bohat si ayatein hain, jin se saf sabit hai ke Huzoor ﷺ ki bisrat rooye zameen ki taraf thi, kul makhlooq ke aap paighambar thay, har surkh-o-siyah ki taraf aap nabi bana kar bheje gaye thay.

(Tarjuma) Surah An'am ki tafsir mein iska poora bayan hum kar chuke hain aur bahut si aayat-o-ahadees wahan وارد ki hain fa-alhamdulillah yahan yeh farmana ki an-parhon ya'ani arbon mein apna Rasool bheja is liye hai ki Hazrat Khalilullah ki dua ki qubooliyat maloom hojaye, Aap ne Ahl-e-Makkah ke liye dua mangi thi ki Allah Ta'ala un mein ek Rasool un hi mein se bheje jo unhe Allah ki aayatein padh kar sunaye, unhe pakeezgi sikhaye aur Kitab-o-Hikmat ki taleem de, pas Allah Ta'ala ne Aap ki yeh dua qubool farmayi aur jabke makhlooq ko Nabi Allah ki sakht haajat thi siwaye chand Ahl-e-Kitab ke jo Hazrat Isa ke sachche deen par qayim the aur ifrat-o-tafrit se alag thi baqi tamam duniya deen-e-haq ko bhula baithi thi aur Allah ki namarzi ke kaamon mein mubtala thi Allah Ta'ala ne Aap ko mabouth farmaya, Aap ne un an-parh ko Allah ke kalam ki aayatein padh sunayin unhe pakeezgi sikhayi aur Kitab-o-Hikmat ka muallim banadiya halanki is se pehle woh khuli gumraahi mein the, suniye arab Hazrat Ibrahim ke deen ke daavedaar the lekin halat yeh thi ki asl deen ko khurd-burd kar chuke the is mein is qadr tabaddul-o-taghaiyur kardiya tha ki tauheed shirk se aur yaqeen shak se badal chuka tha sath hi bahut si apni ijad karda bid'atein deen-e-Allah mein shamil kardi theen, isi tarah Ahl-e-Kitab ne bhi apni kitabon ko badal diya tha un mein tehreef karli thi aur mutaghaiyir kardiya tha sath hi ma'ani mein bhi ulat-pher karli thi pas Allah Pak ne Hazrat Muhammad ﷺ ko azeem-ush-shan shariat aur kamil mukammal deen de kar duniya walon ki taraf bheja ki is fasad ki Aap islah karein, ahl-e-duniya ko asl ahkaam-e-Ilahi pahunchayein Allah ki marzi aur namarzi ke ahkaam logon ko maloom kara dein, jannat se qareeb karne wale azaab se nijat dilwane wale tamam aamal batayein, sari makhlooq ke hadi banein usool-o-furoo sab sikhayein, koi chhoti badi baat baqi na chhodein. Tamam tar shukook-o-shubhat sab ke door kardein aur is deen par logon ko daal dein jin mein har bhalai maujood ho, is buland-o-bala khidmat ke liye Aap mein woh bartariyan aur buzurgiyan jama kar dein jo na Aap se pehle kisi mein theen na Aap ke baad kisi mein ho sakein, Allah Ta'ala Aap par hamesha hamesha durood-o-salam nazil farmata rahe Aameen! Is riwayat se maloom hua ki yeh surat Madani hai aur yeh bhi sabit hua ki Huzoor ﷺ ki paigambari tamam duniya walon ki taraf hai sirf arab ke liye مخصوص nahi kyunke Aap ne is aayat ki tafsir mein faris walon ko farmaya.

Isi aam bisafat ki bina par Aap ne Fars o Room ke badshahoun ke naam islam qabool karne ke faramin bheje. Hazrat Mujahid waghera bhi farmate hain is se murad ajmi log hain yaani Rab ke siva ke jo log Huzoor ﷺ par iman layein aur Aap ki wahi ki tasdeeq karein. Ibn Abi Hatim ki hadith mein hai ke ab se teen teen pushton ke baad aane wale mere ummati baghair hisab ke jannat mein dakhil honge, phir Aap ne isi ayat ki tilawat ki. Woh Allah izzat o hikmat wala hai, apni shariat aur apni taqdeer mein ghalib ba hikmat hai, phir farman hai yeh Allah ka fazal hai yaani An-Hazrat ﷺ ko aisi zabardast azeem-ush-shan nabuwat ke sath sarfaraz farmaana aur is ummat ko is fazal-e-azeem se bahra-war karna, yeh khas Allah ka fazal hai, Allah apna fazal jise chahe de, woh bohat bare fazal o karam wala hai.

(Tarjuma) Surah An'am ki tafsir mein iska poora bayan hum kar chuke hain aur bahut si aayat-o-ahadees wahan وارد ki hain fa-alhamdulillah yahan yeh farmana ki an-parhon ya'ani arbon mein apna Rasool bheja is liye hai ki Hazrat Khalilullah ki dua ki qubooliyat maloom hojaye, Aap ne Ahl-e-Makkah ke liye dua mangi thi ki Allah Ta'ala un mein ek Rasool un hi mein se bheje jo unhe Allah ki aayatein padh kar sunaye, unhe pakeezgi sikhaye aur Kitab-o-Hikmat ki taleem de, pas Allah Ta'ala ne Aap ki yeh dua qubool farmayi aur jabke makhlooq ko Nabi Allah ki sakht haajat thi siwaye chand Ahl-e-Kitab ke jo Hazrat Isa ke sachche deen par qayim the aur ifrat-o-tafrit se alag thi baqi tamam duniya deen-e-haq ko bhula baithi thi aur Allah ki namarzi ke kaamon mein mubtala thi Allah Ta'ala ne Aap ko mabouth farmaya, Aap ne un an-parh ko Allah ke kalam ki aayatein padh sunayin unhe pakeezgi sikhayi aur Kitab-o-Hikmat ka muallim banadiya halanki is se pehle woh khuli gumraahi mein the, suniye arab Hazrat Ibrahim ke deen ke daavedaar the lekin halat yeh thi ki asl deen ko khurd-burd kar chuke the is mein is qadr tabaddul-o-taghaiyur kardiya tha ki tauheed shirk se aur yaqeen shak se badal chuka tha sath hi bahut si apni ijad karda bid'atein deen-e-Allah mein shamil kardi theen, isi tarah Ahl-e-Kitab ne bhi apni kitabon ko badal diya tha un mein tehreef karli thi aur mutaghaiyir kardiya tha sath hi ma'ani mein bhi ulat-pher karli thi pas Allah Pak ne Hazrat Muhammad ﷺ ko azeem-ush-shan shariat aur kamil mukammal deen de kar duniya walon ki taraf bheja ki is fasad ki Aap islah karein, ahl-e-duniya ko asl ahkaam-e-Ilahi pahunchayein Allah ki marzi aur namarzi ke ahkaam logon ko maloom kara dein, jannat se qareeb karne wale azaab se nijat dilwane wale tamam aamal batayein, sari makhlooq ke hadi banein usool-o-furoo sab sikhayein, koi chhoti badi baat baqi na chhodein. Tamam tar shukook-o-shubhat sab ke door kardein aur is deen par logon ko daal dein jin mein har bhalai maujood ho, is buland-o-bala khidmat ke liye Aap mein woh bartariyan aur buzurgiyan jama kar dein jo na Aap se pehle kisi mein theen na Aap ke baad kisi mein ho sakein, Allah Ta'ala Aap par hamesha hamesha durood-o-salam nazil farmata rahe Aameen! Doosri aayat ki tafsir mein Hazrat Abu Hurairah se Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein marwi hai ki hum Aan-e-Hazrat ﷺ ke paas baithe hue the ki Aap par Surah Jumu'ah nazil hui jab Aap ne is aayat ki tilawat farmayi to logon ne poocha ki "Akhireen minhum" se kya murad hai teen martaba Huzoor ﷺ se sawal hua tab Aap ne apna hath Hazrat Salman Farsi R.A ke sar par rakha aur farmaya agar iman Thuraiya sitare ke paas hota to bhi un logon mein se ek ya kai ek pa lete. Is riwayat se maloom hua ki yeh surat Madani hai aur yeh bhi sabit hua ki Huzoor ﷺ ki paigambari tamam duniya walon ki taraf hai sirf arab ke liye مخصوص nahi kyunke Aap ne is aayat ki tafsir mein faris walon ko farmaya.

Isi aam bisafat ki bina par Aap ne Fars o Room ke badshahoun ke naam islam qabool karne ke faramin bheje. Hazrat Mujahid waghera bhi farmate hain is se murad ajmi log hain yaani Rab ke siva ke jo log Huzoor ﷺ par iman layein aur Aap ki wahi ki tasdeeq karein. Ibn Abi Hatim ki hadith mein hai ke ab se teen teen pushton ke baad aane wale mere ummati baghair hisab ke jannat mein dakhil honge, phir Aap ne isi ayat ki tilawat ki. Woh Allah izzat o hikmat wala hai, apni shariat aur apni taqdeer mein ghalib ba hikmat hai, phir farman hai yeh Allah ka fazal hai yaani An-Hazrat ﷺ ko aisi zabardast azeem-ush-shan nabuwat ke sath sarfaraz farmaana aur is ummat ko is fazal-e-azeem se bahra-war karna, yeh khas Allah ka fazal hai, Allah apna fazal jise chahe de, woh bohat bare fazal o karam wala hai.

Kitabon ka bojh lada gadha aur be-amal alim in aayton mein Yahud ki muzammat bayan ho rahi hai ke unhein Taurat ki kitabon ka bojh lad diya jaye toh usay yeh toh maloom hai ke is par koi bojh hai lekin yeh nahi janta ke is mein kya hai? Isi tarah Yahud hain ke zahiri alfaz toh khoob rate hue hain lekin na toh yeh maloom hai ke matlab kya hai? Na is par un ka amal hai balki aur tabdeel-o-tahreef karte rehte hain, pas darasal yeh us be-samajh janwar se bhi badtarin hain, kyunke usay toh qudrat ne samajh hi nahi di lekin yeh samajh rakhte hue phir bhi is ka istemal nahi karte. Isi liye dusri ayat mein farmaya gaya hai: (Tarjuma) Yeh log misl chopayon ke hain balki un se bhi zyada behke hue, yeh gafil log hain. Yahan farmaya Allah ki aayton ke jhutlanewalon ki buri misal hai, aise zalim Allah ki rahnumai se mehroom rehte hain. Musnad Ahmad mein hai jo shakhs Jumah ke din Imam ke khutbah ki halat mein baat kare, woh misl gadhe ke hai jo kitabein uthaye hue ho aur jo usay kahe ke chup reh is ka bhi Jumah jata raha. Phir farmata hai ae Yahud! Agar tumhara dawa hai ke tum haq par ho aur An-Hazrat ﷺ aur aap ke ashab nahaq par hain toh aao aur dua mango ke hum dono mein se jo haq par na ho Allah usay maut de, phir farmata hai ke unhon ne jo aamal aage bhej rakhe hain woh un ke samne hain maslan kufr fojoor zulm nafarmani waghera is wajah se hamari peshingoi hai ke woh is par amadagi nahi karenge, in zalomoon ko Allah ba-khubi janta hai. Surah Baqarah ki ayat Qul in kanat al-kh, ki tafseer mein Yahud ke is mubahale ka pura zikr hum kar chuke hain aur wahin yeh bhi bayan kar diya hai ke murad yeh hai ke apne upar agar khud gumrah ho toh un par toh ya apne muqabil par agar woh gumrah ho maut ki bad-dua karein, jaise ke Nasraniyon ke mubahale ka zikr Surah Al-Imran mein guzar chuka hai, mulahiza ho tafseer ayat Faman hajjaka al-kh, mushrikeen se bhi mubahale ka elan kiya gaya mulahiza ho tafseer Surah Maryam ayat (QUL MAN KANA FI-D-DALALATI FALYA’MDUd LAHU-R-RAHMANU MADDAN) 19. Maryam: 75, yaani ae Nabi ﷺ un se keh de ke jo gumrahi mein ho Rahman usay aur badha de. Musnad Ahmad mein Hazrat Ibn Abbas R.A se marwi hai ke Abu Jahl la'natullah alaihi ne kaha ke agar main Muhammad ﷺ ko Kaaba ke paas dekhunga toh us ki gardan napunga jab yeh khabar Huzoor ﷺ ko pohnchi toh aap ne farmaya agar yeh aisa karta toh sab ke dekhte farishte usay pakad lete aur agar Yahud mere muqabale par aa kar maut talab karte toh yaqinan woh mar jate aur apni jagah Jahannam mein dekh lete aur agar mubahale ke liye log nikalte toh woh laut kar apne ahl-o-maal ko hargiz na pate.

Yeh hadith Bukhari, Tirmidhi aur Nasai mein bhi maujood hai, phir farmata hai maut se toh koi bach hi nahi sakta, jaise Surah An-Nisa mein hai (tarjuma) yaani tum jahan kahin bhi ho wahan tumhein maut paa hi legi go mazboot mahalon mein ho. Mu'jam Tabarani ki ek marfoo hadith mein hai maut se bhagne wale ki misaal aisi hai jaise ek lomri ho jis par zameen ka kuch qarz ho woh is khauf se ke kahin yeh mujh se maang na baithe, bhage, bhagte bhagte jab thak jaye tab apne bhat mein ghus jaye jahan ghusi aur zameen ne phir is se taqaza kiya ke lomri mera qarz ada kar do phir wahan se dum dabaye hue tezi se bhagi akhir yunhi bhagte bhagte halak ho gayi.

Jumma ka din kya hai? Iski ahemiyat kyun hai? Jumma ka lafz 'jam' se mushtaq hai, wajah-e-ishtiqaq yeh hai ke is din musalman bari bari masjido mein Allah ki ibadat ke liye jama hote hain aur yeh bhi wajah hai ke isi din tamam makhlooq kamil hui. Chhay din mein saari kainat banayi gayi hai, chhatta din Jumma ka hai. Isi din Hazrat Adam (Alaihis Salam) paida kiye gaye, isi din jannat mein basaye gaye aur isi din wahan se nikale gaye. Isi din mein qayamat qaim hogi. Is din mein ek aisi saat hai ke us waqt musalman banda Allah Ta'ala se jo talab kare, Allah Ta'ala use inayat farmata hai, jaise ke sahih ahadees mein aaya hai. 

Ibn Abi Hatim mein hai ke Rasoolullah (ﷺ) ne Hazrat Salman se pucha: Jaante ho Jumma ka din kya hai? Unhone kaha: Allah Ta'ala aur Uske Rasool (ﷺ) ko ziyada ilm hai. Aap ne farmaya: Isi din tere maan baap (yaani Adam-o-Hawa) ko Allah Ta'ala ne jama kiya. Ya yun farmaya ke tumhare baap ko jama kiya. Isi tarah ek mauqoof hadees mein Hazrat Abu Hurairah (Razi Allahu Anhu) se marwi hai, wallahu A'lam. 

Pehle isse 'Yaum-ul-Arooba' kaha jata tha. Pehli ummato ko bhi har saat din mein ek din diya gaya tha, lekin Jumma ki hidayat unhe na hui. Yahudiyon ne hafta pasand kiya jis mein makhlooq ki paidaish shuru bhi na hui thi, Nasara ne itwar ikhtiyar kiya jis mein makhlooq ki paidaish ki ibtida hui hai aur is ummat ke liye Allah Ta'ala ne Jumma ko pasand farmaya, jis din Allah Ta'ala ne makhlooq ko pura kiya tha. 

Jaise Sahih Bukhari ki hadees mein hai ke hum duniya mein aane ke aitbaar se toh sab ke peeche hain, lekin qayamat ke din sab se pehle honge, siwae iske ke unhe hum se pehle Kitabullah di gayi, phir unke is din mein unhone ikhtilaf kiya. Allah Ta'ala ne humein raah-e-rast dikhayi, pas log is mein bhi hamare peeche hain: Yahudi kal aur Nasrani parso. Muslim mein itna aur bhi hai ke qayamat ke din tamam makhlooq mein sab se pehle faisla hamare bare mein kiya jaye ga. 

Yahan Allah Ta'ala momino ko Jumma ke din apni ibadat ke liye jama hone ka hukum de raha hai. 'Sa'i' se murad yahan dorna nahi, balke matlab yeh hai ke zikrullah yaani namaz ke liye qasd karo, chal paro, koshish karo, kaam-kaaj chhod kar uth khade ho jao. Jaise is aayat mein sa'i koshish ke maani mein hai: "Wa man aradal-akhirata wa sa'a laha sa'yaha" (yaani jo shakhs akhirat ka irada kare phir uske liye koshish bhi kare). 

Hazrat Umar bin Khattab (Razi Allahu Anhu) aur Hazrat Abdullah bin Mas'ud (Razi Allahu Anhu) ki qiraat mein bajae 'fas'au' ke 'famdu' hai. Yeh yaad rahe ke namaz ke liye dor kar jana mana hai. Bukhari-o-Muslim mein hai: Jab tum iqamat suno toh namaz ke liye sakeenat aur waqar ke sath chalo, doro nahi, jo pao padh lo, jo foot ho ada kar lo. Ek aur riwayat mein hai ke Aap namaz mein the ke logo ke paun ki aahat zor zor se suni, farigh ho kar farmaya: Kya baat hai?

Logon ne kaha Hazrat hum jaldi jaldi namaz mein shamil huwe farmaya aisa na karo namaz ko itminan ke sath chal kar aao jo pao parh lo jo choot jaye poori karlo, Hazrat Hasan farmate hain Allah ki qasam yahan yeh hukm nahi ke dor kar namaz ke liye aao yeh to mana hai balki murad dil aur niyat aur khushoo khuzu hai, Hazrat Qatada farmate hain apne dil aur apne amal se koshish karo, jaise aur jagah hai falama balagha ma'ahu as-sa'y Hazrat Zabihullah jab Khalilullah ke sath chalne phirne ke qabil ho gaye, jum'ah ke liye aane wale ko ghusal bhi karna chahiye, Bukhari Muslim mein hai ke jab tum mein se koi jum'ah ki namaz ke liye jaane ka irada kare woh ghusal kar liya kare, aur hadith mein hai jum'ah ke din ka ghusal har baligh par wajib hai aur riwayat mein hai ke har baligh par satwein din sar aur jism ka dhona hai, Sahih Muslim ki hadith mein hai ke woh din jum'ah ka din hai, Sunan Arba'ah mein hai jo shakhs jum'ah ke din achhi tarah ghusal kare aur sawere se hi masjid ki taraf chal de paidal jaye sawar na ho aur imam se qareeb ho kar baithe khutbe ko kaan laga kar sune lagho kaam na kare to usse har ek qadam ke badle saal bhar ke rozon aur saal bhar ke qiyam ka sawab hai, Bukhari Muslim mein hai jo shakhs jum'ah ke din janabat ke ghusal ki tarah ghusal kare, awwal sa'at mein jaye usne goya ek oont Allah ki rah mein qurban kiya doosri sa'at mein jaane wala misl gaye ki qurbani karne wale ke hai, teesri sa'at mein jaane wala murgh rah-e-Allah mein tasadduq karne wale ki tarah hai, panchwein sa'at mein jaane wala anda rah-e-Allah dene wale jaisa hai, phir jab imam aaye farishte khutba sunne ke liye hazir ho jate hain, mustahab hai ke jum'ah ke din apni taqat ke mutabiq achha libas pehne khushbu lagaye miswak kare aur safai aur pakeezgi ke sath jum'ah ki namaz ke liye aaye, ek hadith mein ghusal ke bayan ke sath hi miswak karna aur khushbu milna bhi hai, Musnad Ahmad mein hai jo shakhs jum'ah ke din ghusal kare aur apne ghar walon ki khushbu mele agar ho aur achha libas pehne phir masjid mein aaye aur kuch nawafil parhe agar jee chahe aur kisi ko eza na de (yani gardanein phalang kar na aaye na kisi baithe huwe ko hataye) phir jab imam aa jaye aur khutba shuru ho khamoshi se sune to uske gunah jo is jum'ah se lekar doosre jum'ah tak ke hon sab ka kaffara ho jata hai, Abu Dawood aur Ibn Majah mein hai Hazrat Abdullah bin Salam (R.A) farmate hain ke maine Rasoolullah (ﷺ) se minbar par bayan farmate huwe suna ke tum mein se kisi par kya harj hai agar woh apne roz marah ke mehnti libas ke alawa do kapre khareed kar jum'ah ke liye مخصوص rakhay. Huzoor (ﷺ) ne yeh farman us waqt farmaya jab logon par wohi mamooli chadrein dekheen to farmaya ke agar taqat ho to aisa kyun na karlo.

Jis azan ka yahan is ayat mein zikr hai us se murad woh azan hai jo Imam ke mimar par baith jaane ke baad hoti hai Nabi ﷺ ke zamane mein yahi azan thi jab Aap ghar se tashreef late mimar par jate aur Aap ke baith jaane ke baad Aap ke samne yeh azan hoti thi, is se pehle ki azan Huzoor ﷺ ke zamane mein na thi isse Amir-ul-Momineen Hazrat Usman bin Affan R.A ne sirf logon ki kasrat ko dekh kar zyada kiya. Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein hai Nabi ﷺ, Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddique aur Hazrat Umar Farooq ke zamane mein Jum'ah ki azan sirf usi waqt hoti thi jab Imam mimar par khutba kehne ke liye baith jata, Hazrat Usman ke zamane mein jab log bohat zyada ho gaye toh Aap ne doosri azan ek alag makan par kahwayi zyada ki is makan ka naam Zura tha masjid se qareeb sab se buland yahi makan tha. Hazrat Makhool se Ibn Abi Hatim mein riwayat hai ke azan sirf ek hi thi jab Imam aata tha us ke baad sirf takbeer hoti thi, jab namaz khadi hone lage, isi azan ke waqt khareedo-farokht haram hoti hai, Hazrat Usman R.A ne is se pehle ki azan ka hukum sirf is liye diya tha ke log jama ho jayein. Jum'ah mein aane ka hukum azad mardon ko hai aurton, ghulamon aur bachon ko nahi, musafir, mareez aur teemar-dar aur aise hi aur uzr wale bhi maazoor gine gaye hain jaise ke Kutub-e-Furooh mein is ka saboot mojood hai. Phir farmata hai bay' ko chhor do yaani Zikrullah ke liye chal pado tijarat ko tark kar do, jab namaz-e-jum'ah ki azan ho jaye Ulama-e-Kiram R.H ka ittifaq hai ke azan ke baad khareedo-farokht haram hai, is mein ikhtilaf hai ke dene wala agar de toh woh bhi sahi hai ya nahi? Zahir ayat se toh yahi maloom hota hai ke woh bhi sahi na thehrega wallahu a'lam, phir farmata hai bay' ko chhor kar Zikrullah aur namaz ki taraf tumhara aana hi tumhare haq mein deen-o-duniya ka behtari ka bais hai agar tum mein ilm ho. Haan jab namaz se faraghat ho jaye toh is majma se chale jana aur Allah ke fazal ki talash mein lag jana, tumhare liye halal hai. Irak bin Malik R.A Jum'ah ki namaz se farigh ho kar laut kar masjid ke darwaze par khade ho jate aur yeh dua padhte (tarjumah) yaani اے اللہ میں نے تیری آواز پر حاضری دی اور تیری فرض کردہ نماز ادا کی پھر تیرے حکم کے مطابق اس مجمع سے اٹھ آیا، اب تو مجھے اپنا فضل نصیب فرما تو سب سے بہتر روزی رساں ہے (Ibn Abi Hatim) is ayat ko pesh-e-nazar rakh kar ba'z Salaf-e-Saliheen ne farmaya hai ke jo shakhs Jum'ah ke din namaz-e-jum'ah ke baad khareedo-farokht kare use Allah Ta'ala sattar hisse zyada barkat dega. Phir farmata hai ke khareed-farokht ki halat mein bhi Zikrullah kiya karo duniya ke nafa mein is qadar mashghool na ho jao ke ukhrawi nafa bhool baitho. Hadith Sharif mein hai jo shakhs kisi bazar jaye aur wahan (tarjumah) padhe Allah Ta'ala us ke liye ek lakh nekiyan likhta hai aur ek lakh buraiyan maaf farmata hai. Hazrat Mujahid farmate hain banda kaseer-uz-zikr usi waqt kahlata hai jabke khade, baithte, lete har waqt Allah ki yaad karta rahe.

Jumma ka din kya hai? Iski ahemiyat kyun hai? Jumma ka lafz 'jam' se mushtaq hai, wajah-e-ishtiqaq yeh hai ke is din musalman bari bari masjido mein Allah ki ibadat ke liye jama hote hain aur yeh bhi wajah hai ke isi din tamam makhlooq kamil hui. Chhay din mein saari kainat banayi gayi hai, chhatta din Jumma ka hai. Isi din Hazrat Adam (Alaihis Salam) paida kiye gaye, isi din jannat mein basaye gaye aur isi din wahan se nikale gaye. Isi din mein qayamat qaim hogi. Is din mein ek aisi saat hai ke us waqt musalman banda Allah Ta'ala se jo talab kare, Allah Ta'ala use inayat farmata hai, jaise ke sahih ahadees mein aaya hai. 

Ibn Abi Hatim mein hai ke Rasoolullah (ﷺ) ne Hazrat Salman se pucha: Jaante ho Jumma ka din kya hai? Unhone kaha: Allah Ta'ala aur Uske Rasool (ﷺ) ko ziyada ilm hai. Aap ne farmaya: Isi din tere maan baap (yaani Adam-o-Hawa) ko Allah Ta'ala ne jama kiya. Ya yun farmaya ke tumhare baap ko jama kiya. Isi tarah ek mauqoof hadees mein Hazrat Abu Hurairah (Razi Allahu Anhu) se marwi hai, wallahu A'lam. 

Pehle isse 'Yaum-ul-Arooba' kaha jata tha. Pehli ummato ko bhi har saat din mein ek din diya gaya tha, lekin Jumma ki hidayat unhe na hui. Yahudiyon ne hafta pasand kiya jis mein makhlooq ki paidaish shuru bhi na hui thi, Nasara ne itwar ikhtiyar kiya jis mein makhlooq ki paidaish ki ibtida hui hai aur is ummat ke liye Allah Ta'ala ne Jumma ko pasand farmaya, jis din Allah Ta'ala ne makhlooq ko pura kiya tha. 

Jaise Sahih Bukhari ki hadees mein hai ke hum duniya mein aane ke aitbaar se toh sab ke peeche hain, lekin qayamat ke din sab se pehle honge, siwae iske ke unhe hum se pehle Kitabullah di gayi, phir unke is din mein unhone ikhtilaf kiya. Allah Ta'ala ne humein raah-e-rast dikhayi, pas log is mein bhi hamare peeche hain: Yahudi kal aur Nasrani parso. Muslim mein itna aur bhi hai ke qayamat ke din tamam makhlooq mein sab se pehle faisla hamare bare mein kiya jaye ga. 

Yahan Allah Ta'ala momino ko Jumma ke din apni ibadat ke liye jama hone ka hukum de raha hai. 'Sa'i' se murad yahan dorna nahi, balke matlab yeh hai ke zikrullah yaani namaz ke liye qasd karo, chal paro, koshish karo, kaam-kaaj chhod kar uth khade ho jao. Jaise is aayat mein sa'i koshish ke maani mein hai: "Wa man aradal-akhirata wa sa'a laha sa'yaha" (yaani jo shakhs akhirat ka irada kare phir uske liye koshish bhi kare).

Tijarat Ibadat Aur Salat-e-Jum'ah٭٭ Madinah mein Jum'ah wale din tijarti maal ke aa jaane ki wajah se jo hazraat khutbah chhod kar uth khade hue the, unhe Allah Ta'ala otaab kar raha hai ki yeh log jab koi tijarat ya khel tamasha dekh lete hain toh uski taraf chal khade hote hain aur tujhe khutbah mein hi khada chhod dete hain. Hazrat Muqatil bin Hayyan farmate hain yeh maal-e-tijarat Dihyah bin Khalifa ka tha, Jum'ah wale din aaya aur shehar mein khabar ke liye tabl (dhol) bajne laga. Hazrat Dihyah us waqt tak Musalman na hue the, tabl ki aawaz sun kar sab log uth khade hue sirf chand aadmi reh gaye. Musnad Ahmad mein hai sirf barah aadmi reh gaye baaqi log us tijarti qafila ki taraf chal diye jis par yeh aayat utri. Musnad Abu Ya'la mein itna aur bhi hai ke Huzoor ﷺ ne farmaya agar woh bhi baaqi na rehte aur sab ki taraf chal diye jis par yeh aayat utri. Musnad Abu Ya'la mein itna aur bhi hai ke Huzoor ﷺ ne farmaya agar yeh bhi baaqi na rehte aur sab uth kar chale jaate toh tum sab par yeh wadi aag ban kar bhadak uthti. Jo log Huzoor ﷺ ke paas se nahi gaye the, un mein Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddique aur Hazrat Umar Farooq Razi Allahu Anhuma bhi the. Is aayat se yeh bhi maloom hua ke Jum'ah ka khutbah khade ho kar padhna chahiye. Sahih Muslim mein hai Nabi ﷺ Jum'ah ke din do khutbe padhte the, darmiyan mein baith jaate the, Quran Sharif padhte the aur logon ko tazkira-o-naseehat farmate the. Yahan yeh baat bhi maloom rehni chahiye ke yeh waqiya bi-qaul ba'z ke us waqt ka hai jab Aan-e-Hazrat ﷺ Jum'ah ki namaz ke baad khutbah padha karte the. Maraseel-e-Abu Dawud mein hai ke Rasool Allah ﷺ khutbah se pehle Jum'ah ki namaz padha karte the jaise Eydain mein hota hai, yahan tak ke ek martaba Aap khutbah suna rahe the ke ek shakhs ne aa kar kaha Dihyah bin Khalifa maal-e-tijarat lekar aa gaya hai, yeh sun kar siwaaye chand logon ke aur sab uth khade ho gaye. Phir farmata hai Ae Nabi ﷺ unhe khabar suna do ke dar-e-akhirat ka sawab Indallah hai, woh khel tamashon se, kharido-farokht se bahut hi behtar hai. Allah par tawakkul rakh kar, talab-e-rizq auqat-e-ijazat mein jo kare Allah use behtareen tareeq par roziyan dega. Alhamdulillah Surah Jum'ah ki tafseer poori hui.
